overview: Badi Dooooor Se Aaye Hai is a story of 5 extra-terrestrial people, from a different galaxy. They have come to earth in search of their lost son. These 5 aliens consist of a father, mother and their 3 children. Few years back they had lost their youngest son while travelling through our galaxy. Since then they have been searching for him from planet to planet.This hunt of theirs had got them to our planet earth.
title: Badi Dooooor Se Aaye Hai

overview: Spouses Igor Yurich and Tatiana, as well as their son Federico Polupanov, are not an ordinary family. They live in their own universe, where you can dig a hole without a shovel, have lunch without food and escape from prison without getting into it. Therefore, when Natalia, a social worker, appears on the doorstep, the Polupanovs refuse the offer to move to more comfortable conditions under the state renovation program — they feel good here. Since the Polupanovs are absolutely not interested in money, Natalia uses any methods that will help to relocate the family: from fictional ghosts in the house and inviting guardianship authorities to organizing a revolt of the village against the Polupanovs. But the desperate attempts of the social worker to free up the living space are broken every time by new oddities of the family.
title: Полупановы

overview: Four young people leave for the adventure of a lifetime: they work as an au pair for three months. In addition to the daily care of children, they all pursue their own dreams and desires. How do they survive far from their familiar environment?
title: Au Pairs

overview: Thunder Alley is an American sitcom which aired from March 9, 1994 to July 4, 1995 on ABC. The show stars Edward Asner as retired race-car driver Gil Jones. The unaired original pilot episode featured Felicity Huffman in the role of Bobbi Turner, Gil's daughter. When ABC picked up the series, Huffman was replaced with actress Diane Venora. The pilot was reshot and Venora played the role for eight episodes before she was replaced by Robin Riker, who played the role for the remainder of the series. The series also starred future Academy Award-nominee Haley Joel Osment. The story involved Bobbi returning after a divorce to live with her father. In tow were her three children: Claudine (Kelly Vint); Jenny (Lindsay Felton); and Harry (Haley Joel Osment). The new family quintet lived in Gil's home above Thunder Alley, the specialty racing garage Gil operated. Rounding out the cast was Gil's dim-witted mechanic sidekick, Leland DuParte (Jim Beaver). In the show's second season, Andrew Keegan joined the cast as Jack Kelly, a local boy who helped around the garage.
title: Thunder Alley

overview: Melissa Etheridge: I'm Not Broken tells an inspiring story of healing and transcendence through the power of music when five female residents from the Topeka Correctional Facility, a women's prison in Kansas, write letters to Etheridge that she then uses as inspiration to create and perform an original song for them. Having recently lost her son to opioids, Etheridge works to understand and interrupt the cycle of addiction while connecting with these women who, so often, are forgotten by society.
title: Melissa Etheridge: I'm Not Broken

overview: 1994. A horrific helicopter crash in the Mull of Kintyre wipes out Northern Ireland's top intelligence personnel. The pilots are blamed - and a fight for truth and justice begins.
title: Chinook: Zulu Delta 576

overview: In 2003, when a small mining town in Ningxia faced relocation, a burned female corpse was discovered outside the police station. The circumstances of her death bore a striking resemblance to a brutal unsolved case from a decade earlier. Veteran detective Zhu Zhiqiang, nearing retirement, teamed up with Zhang Tao, who had been transferred to the mining town's criminal investigation unit due to a work-related mistake. Together, they worked to unravel the case, uncovering the tragic truths buried in the town's past as the relocation unfolded.
title: Let Wind Go By

overview: The story revolves around an ordinary youth named Ye Fan who gets pulled into a strangle unknown world and embarks on a wondrous adventure.

overview: s the New Year approaches, a sudden subsidence accident occurred at Luobai Department Store, a long-established shopping mall in Haizhou City, trapping 13 people underground. This race between time and life brings many tests of human nature, morality and faith...
title: The Limbo

overview: The story centers on the conflict between the Human Clan and the Demon Clan over the mystical Yuli Divine Spring. A free-spirited young girl, Xiao Yao, accidentally enters the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons, triggering a chain of turmoil and drawing her into a series of mysterious cases alongside Hong Ye, the Demon King. Having witnessed the depths of desire and ambition, Hong Ye discovers that Xiao Yao possesses a pure heart untouched by worldly greed.The two uncover the hidden truth behind the struggle surrounding the Yuli Divine Spring.
title: The Unclouded Soul

overview: Li Shuang, a female general of Taijin, takes in an amnesiac man she found by chance, and names him Jin An. An accompanies Shuang wholeheartedly, and the two secretly fall in love. However, when An remembers that he is actually the prince of an enemy state, the two devoted lovers have no choice but to take up arms against each other. Jaded of war, they decide to join forces to resolve the crisis and uphold justice.
title: Shadow Love

overview: Two doctor brothers compete for the love of the same woman. The plot involving this love triangle is full of evil, betrayal, past lives, adoption and love.

overview: Family Law was a compelling drama which tackled complicated legal issues in the field of family law. The attorneys in this Southern California firm served their clients by handling divorce, custody, children's rights and the occasional murder case in the pursuit of justice. CBS cancelled the show in May, 2002 after airing 68 episodes, citing low ratings as the cause of its demise.
title: Family Law

overview: Denise Richards and Her Wild Things will follow Richards, her husband Aaron Phypers and her daughters Sami, Lola and Eloise.
title: Denise Richards and Her Wild Things

overview: Larisa is a strong woman who has long been accustomed to dealing with any problems on her own. She alone raises a difficult teenage son, earns her living through hard work, and has long despaired of finding personal happiness. Larisa's neighbor, wanting to take possession of her house, brings the heroine together with her nephew Oleg, a narrow-minded martinet. Tired of endless loneliness, Larisa tries to build a relationship with him, but the conspiracy is soon revealed... Suddenly, Larisa witnesses how the police detain an undocumented man on the street. Having warmed up to the stranger, the heroine helps him free and pays a fine for him. The next day, the rescued man appears at her house, but not at all to repay the debt - he asks Larisa for an overnight stay. In anger, the heroine drives him away, but subsequent events radically change the woman's attitude towards this man, who appeared so strangely in her life...

overview: Soft and bubbly office lady Ayaka is madly in love with her senior at work, Hiroko! Two lovestruck coworkers who both think the other is straight totally crush on each other.

overview: The story starts with college student Taichi, who comes from a not-so-well-off household and is desperately searching for work. He (literally) stumbles across fellow student Kouhei while on a job hunt, and is incredibly enticed by the delicious bento Kouhei has in hand. However, something seems a bit off about Kouhei and when Taichi consults his friends about it, he gets an answer he really wasn't expecting: Kouhei is severely hearing impaired.
title: I Hear the Sunspot

overview: Fake male and female friend finally meet.
title: Fake Buddies

overview: Little Disasters centers on four friends who were thrown together while expectant mothers with little in common apart from their due dates. When Jess takes her baby daughter to hospital with a head injury she can't explain, close friend and on-duty A&E doctor Liz is forced to make the excruciating decision as to whether to call social services on her friend. The decision sets of a chain of events that show how a moment can fracture and nearly destroy families and friendships.
title: Little Disasters

overview: Forbidden Love follows four couples deeply in love who must come to terms with the one major hurdle complicating their relationships — religion. Hailing from different faiths, one partner from each couple is converting or has decided to relinquish their family-of-origin and culture entirely. Facing such intense traditional differences, can their relationships endure the trials of converting or will their love falter under the pressure? A compelling exploration of the ties that bind.
title: Forbidden Love

overview: The Golden Palace is an American sitcom that originally aired on CBS from September 18, 1992, to May 14, 1993. The show is a spin-off of the sitcom The Golden Girls, continuing the story from that series. CBS cancelled the spin-off in 1993 after one season. The Golden Palace begins where The Golden Girls had ended, in the quartet's now-sold Miami house. With Dorothy Zbornak having married and left in the previous series finale, the three remaining cast members (Dorothy's mother, Sophia Petrillo, Rose Nylund and Blanche Devereaux) decide to invest in a Miami hotel that is up for sale. The hotel, however, is revealed to have been stripped of all of its personnel in an effort to appear more profitable, leaving only two employees: Roland Wilson, the hotel's manager, and Chuy Castillos, the hotel's chef. This requires the women to perform all the tasks of the hotel's staff. The series focused on the interactions between guests at the hotel and the hotel's staff, as well as between the Golden Girls and the previous hotel staff. Guest stars were frequent, including recurring characters that had previously appeared on The Golden Girls, such as Debra Engle and Harold Gould as Rebecca Devereaux and Miles Webber, and other celebrities (Bea Arthur reprised the Dorothy Zbornak role for a two-part storyline in which she visits the hotel to check up on her mother). Following the cancellation of the series, Sophia moves into the Shady Pines retirement home, appearing as a cast member in the later seasons of Empty Nest. What became of Rose, Blanche and the hotel is left unresolved.
title: The Golden Palace

overview: Welcome to Mont-Rouge, a splendid isolated coastal town in New Brunswick. As we celebrate the end of the tourist season, the savage and inexplicable murder of a man involved in the community disrupts this charming, uneventful village.

overview: Rahti is a domestic drama series about international human smuggling and a group of people who have to deal with it. A young Eritrean woman loses her husband and her daughter while fleeing to Finland, a pair of brothers who have run into financial difficulties steal a van with people hidden inside, and a lawyer who has been waiting for adoption for years becomes the guardian of a child whose parents' whereabouts are unknown.

overview: Filmed over the course of two years, My Trans Life offers an intimate portrait of the lives of five young transgender people on their journey to transition. If you are affected by any of the issues raised in this show, you can visit rte.ie/support for helpline information

overview: America's "most mentally ill family" reveals the terrifying true story of how schizophrenia ripped through their family, affecting six of 12 siblings.

overview: Charlie Cooper's Myth Country will follow him as he tours the UK in his campervan, investigating everything from Crop Circles and UFOs in Wiltshire to roaming ghost dogs on the coast and countryside of East Anglia. Charlie will meet the believers and the naysayers, visiting iconic locations and gathering evidence in a bid to get to the bottom of the truth. In an era of social media misinformation and online echo chambers, where can we go to separate the news from the nonsense? The happenings from the hoaxes? The facts from the fiction? This series will see Charlie search spooky small-town goings on, uncovering eye-witness accounts and elusive evidence as well as staging his own experiments in a bid to bring him closer to the truth. Along the way, he will pay homage to the countryside legends of brilliant Britain and will explore how they have come to define the places and people they originate from.

overview: Set in Israel, Jezabel tells the story of a Phoenician princess who uses her beauty and seduction power to achieve all she wants. She marries King Ahab to become queen, but she suffers strong opposition from the Israelite people in attempting to impose on everyone the worship of the pagan gods Baal and Asherah. Stubborn and unwavering in her convictions, Jezabel is a woman capable of anything to achieve her goals and destroy her enemies. She has Elijah as the greatest adversary, a powerful prophet whose sole mission is to spread the word of the One God and to defend the Israelis.

overview: Can a group of real estate scammers pull off a 10-billion-yen scam without getting caught? This is the intriguing premise of Tokyo Swindlers, a masterful crime thriller about realty fraudsters driven by greed.

overview: Billy Hayes' legendary escape from a Turkish prison was the basis for the Oscar-winning movie Midnight Express. Now, with his unique first hand experience Billy takes us into the world of the Greatest Prison Escapes! Through reenactments, we'll experience audacious jail and prison breaks in dramatic form. We'll hear intriguing interviews with the survivors, witnesses, historians, and law enforcement of each event. We'll meet the prisoners. Experience the private hells. The risks, rewards, and failures. One by one, with each dangerous and thrilling step, host Billy Hayes will present to the audience a vivid tour of the Greatest Prison Escapes!

Gradually, envy of the personal and professional success of Tina and Stas gets stronger and stronger, and now the ill-wisher is ready to step over a lot in order to steal the husband from her ""sworn"" girlfriend.

However, scientific community does not appreciate Anton's piece of work which causes Vedernikov (Alexander Samoilenko), head of Scientific Research Institute, to put Ponomarev's laboratory under threat of being shut down. Fortunately, the situation is being resolved thanks to Anton's old friend Leonid Lazarev (Egor Beroev), a successful businessman, who possesses broad connections in political and business circles. Childhood friends establish a joint venture to finish the implant development and perform its market launch. Leonid finds an Indian investor who is ready to support the venture. But the invention is to be tested earlier than planned. Anton's tutor's granddaughter suffers a terrible spinal cord injury. In order to save her Ponomarev at his own risk inserts the implant that has not been certified yet. The surgery goes well. Anton places a similar implant into his own arm in order to experience the same as his patient and be able to help her. Being full of hopes Anton flies to India to conduct negotiations but the plane crashes. Anton found miraculously alive but disfigured is taken to a local hospital where he is found out to suffer full memory loss. Many of them result in patients' deaths... and only Anton who bears a clue to the puzzle in his arm can explain why... Anton's way to happiness will be long and winding. Undergoing a plastic surgery, regaining memory and realizing who he is are in store for him. He will have to make a hard choice between his family left in Moscow who believes he is dead and his new Indian love, Maya. After several days of dating in the darkroom, the participants will select the one member of the opposite sex that they want to see revealed in the light. For the first time, the participants will see whom they've been dating, wooing, kissing, snuggling with and forming bonds with. title: Red Swan

overview: Ilya Zakharov and Alexander Rambo Pushkov will check the aptitude of chefs all over Russia to get them into the best restaurants in the country. Unscrupulous chefs will be permanently blacklisted, and for providing high-quality services, the masters will receive double wages and, possibly, a dream job.
title: Черный список. На кухне

overview: A bold experiment from the TNT channel, in which magicians, mediums, parapsychologists, psychics and other people with extraordinary abilities will try to prove that magic exists. 13 heroes of the project will gather in the most mystical city of Russia - St. Petersburg, to unravel the famous mysteries of the past, touch centuries-old legends and help celebrities who find themselves in paranormal and mystical situations. Our team of superheroes, using their unusual talents, will work together to unravel the most unexpected and mysterious stories. And all in order to, together with the viewer, test reality for strength and separate fantasies from incredible reality, expose some myths and confirm others. During the project, the heroes live together, and this will help both the viewer and the participants to immerse themselves as deeply as possible into the otherworldly world, not only in completing tasks, but also in unpacking themselves. At the end of the project, the winner will receive a cash prize.
title: Место силы

overview: Connected by a mysterious antique pocket watch, Zhang Jing Chan and Li Wei Yi are suddenly transported back in time, where they discover their souls have been swapped. Forced to live each other's lives, they become determined to protect their families and rewrite the painful fates that bind them. As the two navigate tangled timelines, hidden truths, and growing emotional burdens, they realize that changing destiny may be far more complicated—and dangerous—than they ever imagined
title: A Chan

overview: The CMA Music Festival is a four-day music festival centered on country music hosted each June by the Country Music Association in Nashville, Tennessee. Beginning in 1972 as Fan Fair, the event now draws over 400 artists and celebrities who hold autograph sessions and perform in one of the many concerts offered throughout the festival.
title: CMA Fest
Jing Hong Yi Xiao Re Tian Jiao

overview: Summit of Our Youth is a youth fantasy drama packed with inspiration and feel-good moments. It follows Gu Xuejiao, a love-obsessed office worker, who unexpectedly travels back to her high school days after getting laid off. Determined to fix past regrets, she shifts her focus from romance to ambition. With the help of the brilliant top student Lin Zhihua, she reinvents her life. And they fall into a sweet, mutual love as they grow together.
title: Summit of Our Youth

overview: Zhang Yi'ang, a police officer who has been away from frontline criminal investigation for years, is dispatched to Sanjiangkou after receiving an anonymous tip from the provincial department. Shortly after arrival, he witnesses the murder of his criminal investigation captain. While clearing himself of suspicion, he unexpectedly arrests a serial killer, quickly gaining prestige. As he focuses his investigation on the gang of Zhou Rong, a wealthy local businessman, the numerous bumbling thieves and their infighting create a butterfly effect that ironically help him and his team. Supposed fate brings him together with all the thieves, and he ultimately prevails, uncovering the motive behind his colleague's murder and bringing the real culprit to justice.
title: Born with Luck

overview: Yang Guang, Deputy Director of the Third Division of National Security, is caught up in a conspiracy involving an international spy organization during a mission. As a series of unexpected incidents unfold, Yang Guang and his team realize they are facing a crisis that threatens the leakage of national secrets. Sensing an earth-shattering conspiracy lurking behind these events, Yang Guang leads his division to investigate. Amid the escalating crisis, a woman named Zhao Yani becomes the focal point of the investigation. Her identity and actions are shrouded in mystery. At times, she appears to obstruct the uncovering of the truth, making her a prime suspect; at other times, she seems to secretly push events forward, leaving everyone guessing about her true intentions. Faced with carefully laid traps by the enemy, Yang Guang refuses to retreat. Instead, he bravely infiltrates the heart of danger. As the situation intensifies, Yang Guang and Zhao Yani, seemingly from opposing camps, are drawn into a complex vortex where the lines between friend and foe blur. Meanwhile, the real enemy hides in the shadows, waiting to strike. Through trials and relentless battles, Yang Guang remains steadfast in his mission. Thanks to a series of daring moves and sharp decisions, he successfully uncovers and thwarts the enemy's conspiracy, preventing the theft of vital national secrets. Only at the story's end does Yang Guang finally uncover Zhao Yani's unique and mysterious identity, and their long conversation becomes a secret between them. Behind the triumph lies profound personal sacrifice and intense moral struggles. Though the immediate threat has been neutralized, Yang Guang and his team know that in a world full of shifting dangers, new threats are always lurking just around the corner.
title: The Secret Path

overview: Two generations of policemen stumbled forward with unwavering determination, searching for the murderer in the maze-like alleys and finally breaking out of the dead ends in their lives.
title: Dead End

overview: Lonely widow Yulia Shumova accidentally sees an American film on TV, the plot of which completely repeats the life story of her late husband Peter and his companion and childhood friend Mikhail Gvozditsky. It follows from the film that the car accident in which Peter died was set up by an unknown avenger in black. In a panic, she rushes to the police, where Gena Mylnikov, recently appointed to a leadership position, does not take her words seriously. But in vain...
title: Соло для пистолета с оркестром

overview: In the center of the plot is a triple murder. A successful businessman Alexander Serebryakov and two pensioners, the Zavyalov family, were shot dead in an elevator. The operatives are not happy with another cold case and are not going to deal with the motives...
title: Эра стрельца
